verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB ships a first-party MCP integration. Coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor and Codex can use it to list services, run SQL and read monitoring, so users can operate the product in natural language through those agents. CHKit adds typed commands that agents can drive. The evidence shows no built-in natural-language interface in the product itself, so natural-language operation depends on an external agent, and the scope covers only listing, SQL and monitoring. Missing for 10: a native natural-language console or assistant, documented coverage of operations beyond list/SQL/monitoring (e.g., scaling, recovery, alert rules), and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Connect coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, Zed) to your databases over MCP: OAuth 2.1, no API keys, tools to list services, run SQL, and read monitoring.
infrastructure an agent can drive, in CI, with a diff you can review
